correctness.rationale: PASS: If two false twins remain white, no vertex uniquely sees one so they never force. When ≤1 white in each class and |A_i|,|B_i|≥2, a blue member exists in every class; force each remaining B_i in i↑ order via blue A_i, then each remaining A_i in i↓ order via blue B_i. This proves sufficiency for arbitrary p and gives the exact product factor. When singleton classes occur, sufficiency may fail (P4 boundary). A finite checker up to order12 is not an infinite proof.
